question: In ascending order of construction start year, for each owned building that is not a subdivision, list the construction start year, the building number, and the year of initial occupancy. Display the construction start year only if it differs from the previous row. If the year of initial occupancy or construction start year is unknown, display 'UNKNOWN'. You should also include a row at the end showing the total number of owned buildings that are not subdivisions, in the format of (null, #building Buildings, null).

WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    BUILDING_NUMBER,
    DATE_BUILT,
    DATE_OCCUPIED,
    CASE WHEN DATE_BUILT IS NULL OR DATE_BUILT = '' THEN 'UNKNOWN'
         ELSE RIGHT(DATE_BUILT, 4) END AS built_year,
    CASE WHEN DATE_OCCUPIED IS NULL OR DATE_OCCUPIED = '' THEN 'UNKNOWN'
         ELSE RIGHT(DATE_OCCUPIED, 4) END AS occ_year
  FROM FCLT_BUILDING
  WHERE OWNERSHIP_TYPE = 'OWNED'
    AND (BUILDING_TYPE IS NULL OR BUILDING_TYPE <> 'SUBDIVISION')
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    built_year,
    occ_year,
    BUILDING_NUMBER,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY built_year, BUILDING_NUMBER) AS rn
  FROM base
),
prev AS (
  SELECT
    r.built_year,
    r.occ_year,
    r.BUILDING_NUMBER,
    r.rn,
    LAG(r.built_year) OVER (ORDER BY r.built_year, r.BUILDING_NUMBER) AS prev_built
  FROM ranked r
)
SELECT
  CASE WHEN prev_built IS NULL OR prev_built <> built_year THEN built_year ELSE NULL END AS construction_start_year,
  BUILDING_NUMBER AS building_number,
  occ_year AS year_of_initial_occupancy
FROM prev
UNION ALL
SELECT
  NULL,
  CONCAT(COUNT(*), ' Buildings'),
  NULL
FROM base
ORDER BY 1 IS NULL, 1, 2

historical_programs.sql_template: WITH OrgDlcStats AS (SELECT d.DLC_KEY, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS organization_count, MIN(o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS min_organization_number FROM `FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY` AS d JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND NOT d.DLC_KEY IS NULL AND o.ORGANIZATION_NAME <> 'ADMISSIONS' AND NOT o.ORGANIZATION_ID IN ('138', '250') GROUP BY d.DLC_KEY, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME), BuildingRoomStats AS (SELECT b.BUILDING_NAME, MAX(r.AREA) - MIN(r.AREA) AS area_range, VARIANCE(r.AREA) AS area_variance, STDDEV(r.AREA) AS area_stddev FROM `FCLT_BUILDING` AS b JOIN `FCLT_ROOMS` AS r ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE b.SITE = 'MIT' AND b.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' GROUP BY b.BUILDING_NAME HAVING COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) > 10 ORDER BY area_range DESC) SELECT ods.DLC_KEY, ods.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ods.organization_count, ods.min_organization_number, brs.BUILDING_NAME, brs.area_range, brs.area_variance, brs.area_stddev FROM OrgDlcStats AS ods CROSS JOIN BuildingRoomStats AS brs

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT b.BUILDING_USE, VARIANCE(r.AREA) AS area_variance, STDDEV(r.AREA) AS area_stddev FROM `FCLT_ROOMS` AS r JOIN `FCLT_BUILDING_HIST` AS b ON r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE NOT r.AREA IS NULL AND NOT b.BUILDING_USE IS NULL AND b.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND b.SITE = 'MIT' GROUP BY b.BUILDING_USE) SELECT ic.BUILDING_USE, ic.area_variance, bh.BUILDING_NAME_LONG AS building_with_largest_area FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN (SELECT b.BUILDING_USE, b.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, SUM(r.AREA) AS total_area, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY b.BUILDING_USE ORDER BY SUM(r.AREA) DESC) AS rn FROM `FCLT_ROOMS` AS r JOIN `FCLT_BUILDING_HIST` AS b ON r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE NOT r.AREA IS NULL AND NOT b.BUILDING_USE IS NULL AND b.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND b.SITE = 'MIT' GROUP BY b.BUILDING_USE, b.BUILDING_NAME_LONG) AS bh ON ic.BUILDING_USE = bh.BUILDING_USE AND bh.rn = 1 ORDER BY ic.area_variance DESC LIMIT 1

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, t0.ROOM_FULL_NAME, t0.AREA, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, t0.DEPT_CODE, t1.NUM_OF_ROOMS FROM `FCLT_ROOMS` AS t0 JOIN `FCLT_BUILDING` AS t1 ON t0.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = t1.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE t0.AREA > 300 AND t1.NUM_OF_ROOMS > 100) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(BUILDING_NAME_LONG) OVER (ORDER BY building_sort, org_sort) = BUILDING_NAME_LONG THEN NULL ELSE BUILDING_NAME_LONG END AS building_name_long, ORGANIZATION_NAME, room_count, avg_area, SPACE_UNIT, org_number_variance, org_number_stddev, DEPT_CODE FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(BUILDING_NAME_LONG) = 1 AND GROUPING(ORGANIZATION_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE BUILDING_NAME_LONG END AS building_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(BUILDING_NAME_LONG) = 0 AND GROUPING(ORGANIZATION_NAME) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(BUILDING_NAME_LONG) = 1 AND GROUPING(ORGANIZATION_NAME) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE BUILDING_NAME_LONG END AS BUILDING_NAME_LONG, CASE WHEN GROUPING(BUILDING_NAME_LONG) = 0 AND GROUPING(ORGANIZATION_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE ORGANIZATION_NAME END AS org_sort, ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ROOM_FULL_NAME) AS room_count, AVG(AREA) AS avg_area, MAX(SPACE_UNIT) AS SPACE_UNIT, VARIANCE(ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS org_number_variance, STDDEV(ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS org_number_stddev, MAX(DEPT_CODE) AS DEPT_CODE FROM inner_cte AS rw JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS o ON rw.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN `FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY` AS d ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN `SPACE_UNIT` AS s ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = s.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND NOT s.DLC_KEY IS NULL GROUP BY BUILDING_NAME_LONG, ORGANIZATION_NAME WITH ROLLUP) AS tbltmp ORDER BY building_sort, org_sort

    DATE_BUILT,

         ELSE RIGHT(DATE_BUILT, 4) END AS built_year,

prev AS (

    r.BUILDING_NUMBER,

  NULL

WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    BUILDING_NUMBER,
    DATE_BUILT,
    DATE_OCCUPIED,
    CASE WHEN DATE_BUILT IS NULL OR DATE_BUILT = '' THEN 'UNKNOWN'
         ELSE RIGHT(DATE_BUILT, 4) END AS built_year,
    CASE WHEN DATE_OCCUPIED IS NULL OR DATE_OCCUPIED = '' THEN 'UNKNOWN'
         ELSE RIGHT(DATE_OCCUPIED, 4) END AS occ_year
  FROM FCLT_BUILDING
  WHERE OWNERSHIP_TYPE = 'OWNED'
    AND (BUILDING_TYPE IS NULL OR BUILDING_TYPE <> 'SUBDIVISION')
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    built_year,
    occ_year,
    BUILDING_NUMBER,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY built_year, BUILDING_NUMBER) AS rn
  FROM base
),
prev AS (
  SELECT
    r.built_year,
    r.occ_year,
    r.BUILDING_NUMBER,
    r.rn,
    LAG(r.built_year) OVER (ORDER BY r.built_year, r.BUILDING_NUMBER) AS prev_built
  FROM ranked r
)
SELECT
  CASE WHEN prev_built IS NULL OR prev_built <> built_year THEN built_year ELSE NULL END AS construction_start_year,
  BUILDING_NUMBER AS building_number,
  occ_year AS year_of_initial_occupancy
FROM prev
UNION ALL
SELECT
  NULL,
  CONCAT(COUNT(*), ' Buildings'),
  NULL
FROM base
ORDER BY 1 IS NULL, 1, 2
